purpose: External design reference for E5; distinguish resource configuration from measured no-go limits.

decisions.subject: resource allocations
decisions.classification: profile configuration, not measured post-build idle memory or fleet density

decisions.subject: package installation storage
decisions.decision: Use block rootfs when installing packages; genericBoot can otherwise use an overlay root.
decisions.application: Keep private block-backed adaptable fixture and explicit administrative setup phase.

decisions.subject: host boundary
decisions.decision: CLI, runtime and one VMM process per VM; confinement before guest entry.
decisions.application: Use isolated hvi helper, private block disks, preopened fixed vsock listeners and native Seatbelt.

decisions.subject: regression gate
decisions.classification: relative same-host branch-versus-base fsbench regression, not absolute launch/preparation/storage limits
decisions.application: Retain E4 matched workloads/durability and repetitions; do not substitute this relative gate for E5.
